skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the nature, phenomena, and content of demographic issues in developing countries.
Recognize population trends and their impact on policy formulation in developing countries.
Describe the nature, phenomena, and content of financial policies in economic development.
Analyze financial policies in different developing countries and formulate appropriate monetary policies.
Compare theoretical and experimental models reflecting trends in agricultural, industrial, and international trade development.
Apply models to formulate sectoral development policies suitable for different stages of development in developing countries.
Select and process domestic and international data to support professional judgments.
Demonstrate teamwork skills, including participation, supervision, and leadership in group activities.
Develop self-learning and research skills to accumulate knowledge.
Develop critical thinking and ethical awareness related to professional duties and social responsibility.
